full_name: Emmy Murphy | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Mathematics Mary I. Bunting Institute Fellow Northwestern University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Emmy Murphy is an assistant professor of mathematics at Northwestern University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Her work is primarily in symplectic topology, a field connecting abstract mathematical geometry with classical mechanics, optics, and modern physics.
